name: Copper
verdict: OAuth is likely offered only to integration partners, so apply to Copper's partner program for client credentials before customers can connect. Until then use per-user API keys; timeline unknown, low confidence.
needGuide: Yes — apply to Copper's partner program first, and ship API-key onboarding in the meantime.

auth.detail: Likely: the standard API uses a per-user API key sent with the user's email in headers. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code is offered to integration partners only, with credentials issued by Copper. Details unverified this session.
